programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programme.desc: 'S37/E9 - Risk It For The Biscuit'. Chef Josh Capon and actor and comedian Lil Rel Howery cheer on chefs Declan Horgan and Melvin 'Boots' Johnson in a mighty battle to defeat Bobby Flay.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay
programme.desc: 'S37/E10 - Ciao, Bella!'. Scott Conant and Madison Bailey root for Ciao House chefs Preston Paine and Corey Becker in an Italian battle before a showdown with Bobby Flay.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S48/E8 - Battle Of The Meats: Beef'. Four chefs battle it out with bovine-centric ingredients. More than one of the competitors decide to show off their raw talent by serving uncooked meat.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S36/E5 - Winners' Whammy Auction'. Guy Fieri welcomes four previous winners back for a non-stop super battle, starting with a dreaded whammy auction.

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S33/E8 - Rulebreaking Recipes'. The hosts beat the winter blues with a taste bud vacation, featuring shrimp and chopped iceberg salad and Caribbean-inspired chicken stew.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple...
programme.desc: 'Diners, Drive-Ins And Dives: Triple D Nation. S4/E12 - Triple D Nation: Biscuits'. Guy samples Irish-inspired egg rolls in Jacksonville, Florida, and an all-American breakfast with an English twist in Ventura, California.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S53/E3 - Buzzworthy Bizarre Baskets'. The basketeers outdid themselves for this special competition, featuring mandatory ingredients that leave the chefs shaking their heads in disbelief.

programme.title: Cutthroat Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S15/E2 - Domo Arigato, Mr. Gelato'. The chefs prep their waffle breakfast sandwich on a table covered with eggs. Later, one chef makes gelato using only tools attached to the statue of David.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S35/E2 - Antonia Vs. Jet, Part 2'. It's freshman week at Guy Fieri's Flavortown Academy, and Jet Tila and Antonia Lofaso teach their teams how to budget with party platters.

programme.title: The Kitchen
programme.desc: 'S26/E5 - Fall Throwdown'. The hosts get creative with their favourite autumn produce. There's easy cheese and cranberry stuffed grilled chicken and a rutabaga, turnip and pear gratin.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S48/E9 - Battle Of The Meats: Bison'. This fierce battle features a lean protein: bison! The first round sees the chefs going in distinct directions with their jellybean and rib appetisers.

programme.title: BBQ Brawl: Flay V. Anderson V. Burrell
programme.desc: 'S4/E6 - Live Fire, Live Wire'. Captains Bobby Flay, Anne Burrell and Sunny Anderson challenge the contenders to serve suckling pig the old-school way - cooked over a live fire!

programme.title: BBQ Brawl: Flay V. Anderson V. Burrell
programme.desc: 'S4/E7 - Fancy Schmancy'. Bobby Flay, Anne Burrell and Sunny Anderson get saucy with wine-infused barbecue, and the contenders use prized cuts of meat to create 5-star feasts.

programme.title: BBQ Brawl: Flay V. Anderson V. Burrell
programme.desc: 'S4/E8 - Triple Rib Showdown'. Bobby Flay, Anne Burrell and Sunny Anderson host a rib festival for the locals. The contenders must impress the public to stay in the game.

programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games
programme.desc: 'S36/E6 - All-Star Fruit!'. Guy Fieri invites three chefs to take on a multi-course fruit showdown! Before they can cook their dishes, the chefs must compete in an auction.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S31/E2 - Family Meals'. Guy Fieri embraces family on this trip. In Ottawa, Canada, two brothers-in-law carry on a decades-long seafood tradition and father-son team in Nevada fire up the BBQ.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: 'S31/E3 - Off The Beaten Path'. Guy Fieri heads to Reno, Nevada, where he tastes a unique twist on the breakfast burrito. In Ottawa, Canada, a 400-year-old cod cake recipe is on the menu.

programme.title: Chopped Junior
programme.desc: 'S6/E7 - Play Nice With Spice'. The heat is on in this spicy competition. First, the kids have to put on their goggles when they tackle red pepper. Then, spicy jam is used for dessert.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: 'S61/E11 - Out For Pork Blood'. Peaches and pancetta in the appetiser basket make for a creative first round. An unusual pork product in the entrée basket is a little bit gory.

programme.desc: 'S33/E9 - Chef Swap'. The hosts trade places and cook dishes in each other's style. Katie Lee Biegel makes a salad with ingredients that represent her fellow co-hosts.
